question: Love can best be expressed in which form of rasa?
solution:
The correct answer is "**Shringaara rasa**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Sanskrit word "***Shringara***" is used to describe feelings of love, passion, ornamentation, and aesthetic sensibility.
 
• Shringar encompasses a variety of forms of ***love***, including romantic love, sibling love, and love for a pet.
 
• ***Parental love ***(vatsalya) and ***devotional love*** (bhakti) are almost rasas in themselves.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ***Rasa***, which means "sap," "essence," or "fluid," is a Sanskrit word.
 
• The word "***essence of human experience***" in the spiritual tradition refers to the emotions that guide human existence.
 
• Tantric holds that there are*** nine*** fundamental human emotions.
 
• However, only three of these rasas are regarded as ***essential*** in the practice of yoga:
 
 
• The ***Vira rasa*** (which refers to the ability to control the breath, mind, and body)
 
• The*** Shanti rasa*** (which refers to the tranquility of equilibrium)
 
• The ***Sringara rasa ***(refers to the spiritual and physical unity achieved through yoga).
